system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

You can infuse a Jutsu you know with a nature release, for your next strike. By spending a Bonus Action, select a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu that requires an attack roll that you know, and spend 1 Superiority Die. The jutsu cast gains a nature release keyword you have access to and becomes infused into your body until the end of your next turn. Before the end of the next turn, the first time you score a hit with an unarmed or weapon attack, you deal your [Weapon Damage] (or [Unarmed Damage]), plus the jutsu’s damage. If the jutsu would require a saving throw to inflict its damage or effects, the affected creature makes its saving throw at disadvantage, suffering its effects as normal on a failure. On a success they take half damage following the jutsu’s listed effect text.
